text: Editable incident dispatch details — Ongoing Incident workspace can now change incident type, priority, address, postal and caller before or after appliance mobilisation, with changes logged in the incident timeline.
Control workflow — removed the standalone New Incident tab. Incoming 999 calls now create the normal ongoing incident directly, and Control can edit/manage/mobilise it from Ongoing Incidents.

999 Control presentation — replaced the large blocking emergency panel with a compact non-blocking 999 notification, persistent sidebar badge and dedicated 999 Calls inbox. Opening a call still hands it into the normal incident form.
Guardian_999 integration — Control now exposes a Receive999Call server export and the incoming 999 call panel; Guardian_999 can hand emergency reports directly into Control.
Appliance skills — added configurable per-callsign skills, pattern rules for G=Wildfire Unit and W=Swift Water Rescue, and explicit K07P1=Turntable Ladder.
